pages.text: Climb four tiers. Each one unlocks new dimensions, materials, crafting systems and magic. Tiers are $(bold)per-player$(), so everyone on a server advances on their own.$(br2)You advance by feeding the $(bold)Iridescent Codex$() token economy (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)). A boss's tier comes from $(italic)where it generates$(), not how hard it hits.

pages.title: Tier 1: Foundations
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Iron, Copper, Brass, Tin, Bronze$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() {{tier 1 Dims}} only$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Create$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Botania, Iron's Spells$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() Diamonds are left out of Overworld chests and worldgen on purpose. Apotheosis affixes are Common-tier only.

pages.title: Tier 2: Expansion
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Steel, Manasteel, Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() {{tier 2 Dims}}$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Thermal Series, Industrial Foregoing (basic)$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Ars Nouveau$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() The first Simply Swords uniques drop from Twilight bosses. Diamonds stay at Tier 3.

pages.title: Tier 3: Dominion
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Diamond (full), Terrasteel, Enderium, Osmium$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() {{tier 3 Dims}}$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Mekanism (basic), Refined Storage, IF (advanced)$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Occultism, Forbidden & Arcanus$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() Ancient Debris becomes accessible. The Nether unlocks here, not at the start of the game.

pages.title: Tier 4: Ascension
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Netherite, Gaia Ingots, Antimatter, Atomic Alloy$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() {{tier 4 Dims}}$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Mekanism (advanced), RFTools Dimensions$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Mahou Tsukai$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() This is the top of the ladder, and defeating the Ender Dragon is the finale.
